desc: Build an adjacency list and obtain an iterative parent/order traversal.
Implement bottom-up DP with each subtree state equal to invalid, zero (fully completed), or one unfinished fragment length.
At each vertex, reject more than two unfinished child fragments; combine two only when their lengths sum to K−1, or extend one by the current vertex.
Handle K=1, where every vertex forms its own path.
Verify the root has no unfinished fragment and print `Yes` exactly in that case.
